papers.title_en: LeHami: Symplectic Latent Dynamics for World Models
papers.authors: Romina Yalovetzky, Randall Balestriero, Yann LeCun
papers.evidence: 以动作条件哈密顿流替换JEPA预测器，稳定世界模型的长程潜空间推演
papers.tldr: JEPA类世界模型在潜空间自回归预测时，长 rollout 可能收缩潜分布并合并不同状态。LeHami 将预测器替换为动作条件哈密顿流，在结构化(q,p)潜状态上用精确辛 leapfrog 积分，并由位置表示的时间导数构造动量分量。在视觉摆任务上，它显著改善长时程速度预测，保持潜体积恒定，并支持未见子帧步长积分与数值时间反演。该工作表明，几何结构可为潜世界模型提供推理时保证，防止长期收缩与状态合并，并与表示正则化互补。
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models directly in latent space, but unconstrained autoregressive predictors may contract the latent distribution over long rollouts. We introduce Symplectic Hamiltonian JEPA (LeHami), which replaces the standard predictor with an action-conditioned Hamiltonian flow over a structured latent state (q, p) integrated using an exactly symplectic leapfrog step. This construction preserves phase-space volume at every rollout step and rules out uniform contraction, asymptotically stable fixed points, and merging of distinct latent states, independently of the learned parameters or action sequence. We obtain the momentum-like component from temporal derivatives of the learned position-like representation, providing an explicit second-order state for prediction and control. On conservative and actuated visual pendulum environments, LeHami substantially improves long-horizon velocity prediction over an unconstrained JEPA world model and empirically maintains constant latent volume where the baseline contracts. The learned flow also supports accurate integration at unseen sub-frame step sizes and numerical time reversal. These results show how geometric structure can provide inference-time guarantees that are complementary to representation regularization in latent world models.

papers.title_en: ProWorld: Multi-View World Model with Proprioceptive Feedback for Closed-Loop Policy Evaluation
papers.authors: Zijun Wang, Tianyi Yan, Haokun Lin, Panwen Hu, Bohang He, Siyu Ren, Xiaoyu Guo, Weijia Liufu, Shuoshuo Xue, Fengjiao Chen, Zipeng Ye, Xuezhi Cao, Zutao Jiang, Hanhui Li, Xiaodan Liang
papers.evidence: 以动作条件世界模型作为机器人策略的闭环评估环境
papers.tldr: 在真实机器人上反复试错来评估策略代价高昂，本文探究动作条件世界模型能否充当闭环测试环境。ProWorld 用共享 Transformer 联合预测多视角视频与机器人本体状态，并将二者反馈给冻结策略以支持重复交互，同时用高保真仿真采集的失败交互数据训练，抑制“漏抓被判为成功提起”的幻觉。在三个策略、四个操作任务上，生成成功率与真实成功率的 Pearson 相关达 0.95、Spearman 达 0.94，TriWorldBench 总分最高。这表明视觉—本体联合反馈与失败感知训练可作为世界模型策略评估的基础。
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating robot manipulation policies through repeated physical trials is costly. We study whether an action-conditioned world model can serve as a closed-loop test environment whose policy success rates track those on real robots. Beyond realistic video, the model must return the camera views and proprioceptive state needed for the policy's next action and preserve failed-action outcomes to avoid overestimating policy capability. We introduce ProWorld, a world model that jointly predicts multi-view video and robot state, then feeds both back to a frozen policy for repeated interaction. ProWorld comprises a shared transformer for joint video-state flow prediction and Shared-Time View Encoding to distinguish cameras while preserving temporal synchronization. To reduce interaction hallucinations that turn missed grasps into successful lifts, we augment training with failed interactions collected in high-fidelity simulation, reducing inflated success rates in the generated environment. ProWorld achieves the highest overall TriWorldBench score among the compared methods. Across three policies and four local manipulation tasks, it attains a Pearson correlation of 0.95 and a Spearman correlation of 0.94 between generated and real success rates. These results support joint visual-proprioceptive feedback and failure-aware training as a basis for world-model-based policy evaluation.

papers.title_en: World Modeling through Spectral Alignment
papers.authors: Holger Molin, William Peng, Marco Bagatella, Randall Balestriero
papers.evidence: SpecWM是通过目标相似核指定观测关系的JEPA框架
papers.tldr: 世界模型需要明确知道该保留哪些信息，本文从谱表示学习角度提出SpecWM。它用目标相似核显式指定观测间关系，并训练编码器在嵌入几何中复现这些关系。时间核在OGBench与CALVIN上把CEM规划成功率大幅提升。这表明显式指定表示几何可有效引导潜世界模型保留控制所需信息。
papers.abstract_en: How do we tell a world model what information to preserve? We study this question through the lens of spectral representation learning. We introduce SpecWM, a JEPA framework that explicitly specifies desired relationships between observations through a target similarity kernel and trains the encoder to reproduce those relationships in its embedding geometry. Different kernels provide different supervision, ranging from physical state information to a fully self-supervised temporal kernel requiring only the ordering of observations within trajectories. We characterize the global optima of the objective, establish conditions for linear recoverability and invariance to nuisance information, and connect temporal-kernel similarity to the behavioral successor measure under an idealized setting. Empirically, the choice of kernel strongly controls which physical quantities are recoverable from the representation. More importantly, temporal spectral alignment improves CEM planning success over LeWorldModel from 52% to 68% on OGBench Cube, 49% to 77% on OGBench Scene, and 29% to 51% on CALVIN. These results suggest that explicitly specifying representation geometry provides a simple way to steer what latent world models preserve for control.

papers.title_en: Vision-Predictor-Action: Towards Efficient Embodied AI via Neuro-Symbolic JEPA Predictors
papers.authors: Yeonseok Lee
papers.evidence: 用JEPA潜在预测与流匹配动作块替代自回归解码，降低机器人控制延迟
papers.tldr: 现有VLA模型逐token自回归生成动作，推理延迟随动作序列增长，限制闭环控制频率。VPA用轻量潜在控制回路替代自回归解码器：共享视觉编码器与冻结文本编码器嵌入观测、目标图像和指令，神经符号选择器选技能，JEPA预测下一潜在状态，流匹配一次生成动作块。在LIBERO-10上，可训练参数不足20M、单步10–14ms，两相机策略200回合成功率40.0%。这为高效具身控制提供了初步可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models commonly generate robot actions token by token through Large Language Model (LLM) decoders, causing inference latency to grow with action sequence length and limiting closed-loop control frequency. We present Goal-Conditioned Vision-Predictor-Action (VPA), which replaces autoregressive decoders with a lightweight latent control loop. A shared vision encoder and a frozen text encoder embed observations, goal images, and instructions; a neuro-symbolic selector chooses a discrete skill; a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) predictor forecasts the next latent state; and a flow-matching solver generates an entire action chunk in a few integration steps, so that sequential network evaluations per decision step do not depend on the action horizon. We analyze inference complexity, regularization against representation collapse, and conditions under which latent sub-goal thresholding limits error accumulation across task phases. As an initial proof of concept, we evaluated VPA on the LIBERO-10 suite. The trainable model has under 20M parameters (checkpoint under 75 MB, excluding a frozen 63.4M-parameter CLIP text encoder); a decision step of a single-camera reference configuration takes 10-14 ms on an Apple M4; and trained only on LIBERO-10 demonstrations in under three hours on a single GPU, a two-camera policy succeeded in 40.0% of 200 evaluation episodes. These preliminary results from a single training run suggest the approach is workable. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/ylee-sling/Vision-Predictor-Action and https://huggingface.co/ylee-sling/vpa-libero10, and archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22960920.

papers.title_en: WoVR+: World Model as Reliable Simulator for Versatile VLA Policy Optimization with RL
papers.authors: Shangqing Zhou, Zhennan Jiang, Ning Ma, Xin Fu, Yupeng Zheng, Shuai Tian, Huangrui Li, Jiahao Liu, Chao Yu, Zhongpu Xia, Haoran Li, Dongbin Zhao
papers.evidence: 以抗幻觉世界模型作为VLA策略强化学习的可靠模拟器
papers.tldr: VLA强化学习依赖真实交互，动作条件世界模型虽能降本，却会因幻觉误导策略优化。WoVR+重设计学习环境与想象交互协议，用对齐VLA接口的世界模型做多视角预测与本体感知更新，并以分块噪声和分阶段局部想象训练支撑长程任务。在RoboTwin与6个真机任务上，成功率较SFT提升21.09%和16.7%，长程手机包装从30%升至75%。
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models can reduce costly real-robot interaction in reinforcement learning for Vision-Language-Action models (VLA-RL), but hallucinations can mislead policy optimization. Extending them to richer VLA interfaces and long-horizon tasks raises challenges in spatiotemporal and cross-modal consistency, exploration-reliability balance in RL, and compounding rollout errors. We present WoVR+, extending WoVR's hallucination-aware WM-RL framework by redesigning the learned environment and imagined interaction protocol: A VLA-interface-aligned world model provides multi-view prediction and proprioceptive updates while mitigating hallucinations. Chunk-wise noise preserves flow-based policy exploration while limiting prediction-degrading action jitter. For long-horizon tasks, stage-local imagined training combines stage-entry resets, stage-specific rewards, local horizons, and controllable sampling to shorten generated prefixes and balance training across stages. WoVR+ improves success over SFT by 21.09% and 16.7% on RoboTwin and 6 real-robot tasks. Long-horizon phone-packaging success rises from 30% to 75%. Videos are available at https://youmo445.github.io/WoVR_Plus.github.io/.

papers.title_en: TRACE: Efficient Transfer Learning for Neural Whole-Body Control Across Humanoid Embodiments
papers.authors: Qingyu Lan, Zhihao Tian, Zifan Wang, Junwei Liang
papers.evidence: 人形全身控制策略的高效跨本体适配
papers.tldr: 人形行为基础模型可提供多样全身控制，但迁移到新本体时受运动学与动力学不匹配制约，微调成本高。TRACE保留预训练运动表征，向输入输出投影层注入运动学先验并对齐关节名义动力学，再用编码器蒸馏、低秩强化学习和两阶段课程在筛选运动集上专门化反馈控制。将SONIC从Unitree G1迁移至Unitree H2使用1000万帧运动、单张RTX PRO 6000约8小时，GPU时成本不足从头训练的0.1%，在67,953条评测运动上成功率达96.08%。真实机器人展示动态运动跟踪与全身遥操作，采集演示还可支撑下游视觉-语言-动作策略后训练，证明跨尺度跨动力学控制器复用可行。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) enable diverse whole-body control, but adapting a pretrained controller to a new embodiment remains challenging because of kinematic and dynamic mismatch. We present TRACE, a framework for efficient cross-embodiment adaptation that preserves pretrained motion representations while specializing feedback control to the target robot.TRACE first injects kinematic priors into input and output projection layers and aligns nominal joint dynamics to reduce embodiment mismatch and support stable fine-tuning. It then combines encoder distillation with low-rank reinforcement learning on a compact, quality-screened motion set, using a two-phase curriculum to establish stable tracking before refining difficult motions. We apply TRACE to transfer SONIC from Unitree G1 to Unitree H2 using 10 million motion frames and approximately eight hours of training on a single RTX PRO 6000 GPU, at less than 0.1% of the GPU-hour cost of training SONIC from scratch. The adapted controller achieves 96.08\% success on 67,953 evaluation motions under a height-scaled tracking criterion. Real-robot demonstrations span dynamic motion tracking and whole-body teleoperation, with collected demonstrations supporting downstream vision-language-action policy post-training. These results demonstrate practical reuse of a pretrained humanoid controller across robots with different body scales and dynamics.

papers.title_en: Cross-Embodiment Affordance Transfer for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Sawera Yaseen, Serge Thill, Rekha Raja
papers.evidence: 以机器人物理属性为条件的跨具身可供性迁移
papers.tldr: 机器人操作常从人类标注数据学习物体可供性，但标注反映人手交互可能性，未必符合特定机器人的几何可达性与机械约束。为此，作者提出跨具身可供性迁移框架，以物体三维点云和机器人几何/约束描述符为输入，将人类可供性标注转化为机器人可执行区域预测。模型利用人类标注与仿真中多次接近试验的执行结果训练，并在家庭物体数据集、UR5e配两种平行夹爪上评估。结果显示其优于不接收机器人信息的基线，表明可供性预测必须条件于机器人本体，仅靠人类标注不足以学习可执行表示。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation systems commonly learn object affordances from human-annotated datasets, which reflect interaction possibilities for a human hand rather than the physical constraints of a specific robot. For example, a surface region of an object identified as graspable by a human annotator may be geometrically unreachable or mechanically infeasible for a robot, yet this mismatch is rarely addressed explicitly. To tackle this challenge, we proposed a framework that translates human affordance annotations into robot-executable affordance predictions conditioned on the physical properties of the robot. The network predicts which surface regions of an object are physically executable by the robot, given a 3D point cloud of an object and a descriptor encoding the robot's geometry and constraints. The model was trained using human-annotated affordances together with robotic execution outcomes from multiple sampled approach trials in simulation, where execution outcomes determined which regions are executable for the robot. The evaluation was performed on a household objects dataset using two parallel-jaw gripper configurations on a UR5e robot arm. The framework outperformed a model that does not receive information about the robot. The experimental results demonstrated that affordance prediction must be conditioned on the robot and that human annotations alone are insufficient for learning robot-executable affordance representations.

papers.title_en: Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence
papers.authors: Thinker Team, Peng Gao, Jichao Jiao, Chen Liao, Daqin Luo, Yiming Ma, Baiyu Pan, Hailin Shi, Jiyuan Wang, Xiangming Xu, Xiongwei Zhao
papers.evidence: 共享动力学Transformer统一建模RGB、深度与机器人动作的多模态世界模型
papers.tldr: 现有具身世界模型多在模态与功能上彼此割裂，视觉动态、几何结构与可执行动作往往经由分离接口或下游模块耦合，而非在共享动力学模型中联合表征与演化。Thinker-WM 以统一的 Unified Dynamics Transformer 搭配模态专属编解码器，将 RGB、度量深度与机器人动作映射到共同的动态表征并共享参数联合演化，同时保留各自输出结构。模型在约2万小时自我中心视频、1万小时真机与1千小时仿真数据上训练，在 EWMBench、WorldOlympiad、WorldArena 三项评测中排名第一。该工作表明外观、几何与动作可在表征层统一建模，并以同一套参数支撑视频-动作生成、世界预测、策略推断等多种功能。
papers.abstract_en: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.

papers.title_en: WAVE-0: Bridging VLA Policies and WAMs with Lightweight Latent Future Prediction
papers.authors: Haomin Wang, Anqiong Ji, Ke Wang, Zhongshan Liu, Ru Ying, Ran Zheng, Zhipeng Zhang
papers.evidence: 轻量潜在世界模型以未来预测增强VLA
papers.tldr: VLA策略擅长通用操作，但未显式建模动作的环境后果；WAM常依赖昂贵视频生成或大规模视频预训练。WAVE-0用轻量潜在世界模型连接预训练VLA与WAM，将潜在动作计划转为未来表征并条件化动作专家，统一规划、预测与动作生成。它在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO达91.47%与98.7%，真实任务将π0.5成功率从38.3%提至73.3%。结果表明无需像素重建或视频预训练即可提升操作性能与分布偏移泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies excel at generalist robotic manipulation but generate actions without explicitly modeling their environmental consequences. World action models (WAMs) incorporate future prediction, yet most rely on costly video generation, while latent alternatives either use predicted futures only as auxiliary targets or infer latent actions from suboptimal visual transitions through costly large-scale video pretraining. We introduce WAVE-0 (World-model-Augmented VLA Execution), a framework that bridges VLAs and WAMs through a lightweight latent world model. By connecting the semantic understanding of pretrained VLAs with explicit future prediction, WAVE-0 allows anticipated action consequences to directly guide action generation. Built on a pretrained VLA, its 257M world model translates VLM-generated latent action plans into predicted future representations that condition the action expert, unifying latent planning, future prediction, and action generation. The world model is trained directly on ground-truth robot actions with a counterfactual ranking objective, requiring neither pixel reconstruction nor large-scale video pretraining. WAVE-0 achieves success rates of 91.47% on RoboTwin 2.0 and 98.7% on LIBERO, along with 88.0%, 61.4%, and 75.0% on LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and LIBERO-Para, respectively. On real-world tasks, it improves the success rate of $π_{0.5}$ from 38.3% to 73.3%. These results demonstrate strong manipulation performance and generalization across diverse distribution shifts.

papers.title_en: Active Generative Simulation: Meta-Learning What to Simulate for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training
papers.authors: Liqian Ma, Vaibhav Saxena, Utkarsh Aashu Mishra, Shuo Cheng, Yongxin Chen, Danfei Xu
papers.evidence: 元学习仿真数据生成分布以缓解真实示范稀缺
papers.tldr: 仿真与真实协同训练能缓解机器人真实数据不足，但现有方法把仿真器视为固定数据源，依赖均匀生成、离线检索或专家手工对齐。本文提出主动生成仿真问题，并设计MetaGenSim元学习框架，用元梯度训练辅助评分网络，在给定参数空间内自动发现高价值数据生成分布。在仿真与真实操作任务中，该方法真实全任务成功率相对均匀生成提升150%，优于检索基线并匹配专家手工对齐。其意义在于将仿真数据分布优化直接服务于下游真实性能，减少人工对齐，并可迁移至VLA微调。
papers.abstract_en: Sim-and-real co-training is an effective way to scale robot learning by augmenting limited real-world demonstrations with simulation data. However, existing approaches typically treat simulators as fixed data sources, relying on uniform generation, offline retrieval, or manual parameter alignment by domain experts. We formulate \textit{Active Generative Simulation}: optimizing a simulator's data-generation distribution to maximize downstream real-world performance. To solve this problem, we propose MetaGenSim, a meta-learning framework that trains an auxiliary rater network via meta-gradients to automatically discover high-utility data-generation distributions within a user-specified simulation parameter space, without manual parameter alignment. Across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, MetaGenSim outperforms uniform generation and retrieval baselines, achieves a 150% relative improvement in real-world full-task success over uniform generation, and matches expert manual alignment. We further show that distributions curated with a lightweight proxy policy transfer to VLA fine-tuning, and that MetaGenSim can exploit partial alignment through atomic skill stitching and object-receptacle composition when exact sim-and-real task alignment is unavailable. Project website: https://meta-gensim.github.io

papers.title_en: PolyMorph: Learning Locomotion Policy for Cross-Embodiment Adaptation
papers.authors: Hyunsik Oh, Seunghun Jeon, Donghoon Youm, Jungwoo Hur, Hyeongjun Kim, Jeong Hyun Lee, Moonkyu Jung, Jemin Hwangbo
papers.evidence: 跨异构机器人形态的单一运动策略
papers.tldr: 腿式机器人强化学习策略通常绑定特定形态，腿数、关节或机械参数一变就需重新工程化。PolyMorph提出形态条件化框架，将URDF解析为关节-连杆模块，结合循环编码器、图Transformer与逐关节解码器，输出可适配变腿数与关节配置的单一策略。训练上用形态归一化奖励、自适应机器人采样和URDF推导的PD增益初始化提升稳定性。仿真覆盖双足、三足、四足及未见形态与平台，并在真实四足多构型部署，证明无需逐机器人重训即可泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has enabled robust locomotion for legged robots, but learned policies are typically tied to a specific robot morphology and require additional engineering when the number of legs, actuators, or mechanical properties change. We present PolyMorph, a morphology-conditioned framework that learns a single locomotion policy for heterogeneous legged robots. PolyMorph converts each robot's URDF into joint-link modules and combines a recurrent encoder, graph-based Transformer, and per-joint decoder to generate actions across variable leg counts and joint configurations. To improve training stability, PolyMorph uses morphology-normalized rewards, adaptive robot sampling, and URDF-derived PD-gain initialization. We evaluate PolyMorph in simulation across bipedal, tripedal, and quadrupedal robots, including unseen morphology variants and platforms, and deploy the policy on real quadruped platforms operated in multiple configurations. The results show that a single PolyMorph policy generalizes across diverse robot morphologies without per-robot policy retraining.

papers.title_en: Accelerating VLA Inference with Perturbation Informed Execution
papers.authors: Jehun Lee, Hajun Lee, Jimin Ryu, Youhan Lee, Beomseok Kang, Jonghyun Choi, Jae-Joon Kim
papers.evidence: 无需训练的动作块与执行时域选择以降低VLA推理调用
papers.tldr: 动作分块VLA模型在固定执行时域下只使用预测前缀，短时域增加策略调用，长时域又削弱精细修正。PICES提出免训练方法，在一次策略调用中由动作专家基于多初始噪声及局部扰动生成候选动作块，利用名义块与扰动块的对应动作差异自适应确定各候选执行时域并选择动作块。实验在仿真与真实操作任务上相较固定时域基线在Jetson Orin/Thor上实现最高2.3倍墙钟推理加速，同时提升成功率。
papers.abstract_en: Action-chunking vision-language-action (VLA) models predict sequences of future robot actions. Under fixed-horizon execution, the robot executes a fixedlength prefix of each predicted chunk before invoking the policy again, leaving the remaining predictions unused. For a given number of executed actions, short execution horizons require more policy calls. Extending the execution horizon amortizes policy inference cost over more actions. However, uniformly applying long horizons across episodes can limit opportunities for precise corrections. To address this limitation, we propose PICES (Perturbation-Informed Chunk and Execution Horizon Selection), a training-free method that jointly selects an action chunk and the number of actions executed before the next policy call. Within a single policy call, the action expert generates a batch of action chunks from multiple initial noise samples and their locally perturbed counterparts, using the same conditioning features across all samples. PICES exploits differences between corresponding actions in each nominal chunk and its counterpart to determine candidate-specific execution horizons and select a nominal chunk for execution. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that PICES achieves speedup by up to 2.3x in wall-clock policy inference time on Jetson Orin and Thor relative to fixed horizon baselines while improving the success rate.

papers.title_en: Enhancing Latent World Models with Associative Memory
papers.authors: Yuwei Sun, Siyu Zhu
papers.evidence: 用联想记忆增强JEPA式潜在世界模型以服务具身规划
papers.tldr: 潜空间世界模型虽可扩展地支持具身规划，但存在表征坍塌、计算开销大和长时程能力弱等问题。作者在JEPA式预测中引入内容可寻址记忆库，直接从观测学习多时间尺度的高层表征，并用自适应层归一化调制预测。他们还设计槽多样性与时间利用均衡两项损失，防止坍塌并提升记忆效率。在多个任务上以轻量架构取得领先结果。
papers.abstract_en: World models trained via latent dynamics offer a scalable path for embodied planning, yet existing methods suffer from representational collapse, computational overhead, and limited long-horizon capability. We introduce a memory-enhanced latent world model that augments JEPA-style prediction with a content-addressable memory bank. Our approach learns high-level representations directly from observations, operating at multiple temporal scales within a shared latent space, and conditions predictions via adaptive layer normalization. To prevent collapse and ensure effective memory usage, we design two complementary losses that encourage slot diversity and balanced temporal utilization. Experiments on PushT, Tworoom, Reacher, and OGBCube demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with a lightweight architecture, outperforming conventional latent world models on long-horizon planning tasks.

papers.title_en: AutoRSR: Automated Real-to-Sim-to-Real Data Generation for Scalable Robot Learning
papers.authors: Jiawei Zhang, Chang Liu, Litao Deng, Tao Zhang, Qin Jin
papers.evidence: 自动化真实到仿真再回真实的数据生成以缓解机器人数据稀缺
papers.tldr: 机器人学习亟需大规模操作数据，但真实示教昂贵，仿真数据构建仍依赖大量人工。AutoRSR 利用多视角观测、机器人状态和开放词汇语义查询，自动重建场景、提取物体资产并完成度量尺度机器人基座配准，再由少量参考动作生成可执行轨迹并扩展。三个真实任务中，每任务1K自动生成回合训练的策略取得73.3–86.7%真实成功率，接近150条人类示教训练的pi 0.5，人工时间降低一个数量级。该框架让真实观测低成本转化为可扩展仿真数据。
papers.abstract_en: Scaling embodied robot learning requires large and diverse manipulation datasets, but collecting real-world demonstrations remains expensive in human effort and robot time. Simulation provides a scalable alternative, yet converting a real workspace into a robot-learning-ready environment still requires substantial manual effort for object extraction, asset processing, coordinate calibration, and trajectory specification. We present AutoRSR, a highly automated real-to-sim-to real framework that converts scanned real-world workspaces into reusable embodied simulation assets and scalable manipulation data. Given multi-view observations, robot states, and open-vocabulary semantic queries, AutoRSR reconstructs the workspace, extracts individual object assets, and automatically registers the reconstructed scene to the robot base frame at metric scale. Starting from a small number of reference motions, AutoRSR then generates executable manipulation trajectories and scales them through trajectory interpolation and domain randomization. After workspace scanning and semantic queries, the remaining pipeline requires no manual object annotation, scene-to-robot calibration, or robot teleoperation. Across three real-world manipulation tasks, policies trained on 1K automatically generated episodes per task achieve 73.3--86.7% real-world success rates, comparable to pi 0.5 trained from 150 human teleoperated demonstrations, while reducing the human time required for data generation by an order of magnitude. These results demonstrate that real-world observations can be converted into metrically aligned, executable, and scalable simulation data with substantially reduced human effort.

papers.title_en: EgoJEPA: Beyond Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Videos
papers.authors: Meng Cao, Can Zhao, Jinjie Wei, Haonan Zhao, Yulong Zhang, Duo Han, Xiaofan Li, Ziwu Song, Rongtao Xu, Ruyi Gan, Hao Wang, Qian Wang, Daolin Ma, Ian Reid, Xiaodan Liang
papers.evidence: 从第一视角人类视频学习与本体无关的潜在动作表示，实现跨本体技能迁移
papers.tldr: 第一人称人类视频可低成本提供操作先验，但传统重定向依赖手工几何映射，跨本体需反复校准且易传播手部追踪误差。EgoJEPA提出三阶段框架：JEPA式视觉预测学习效果感知的潜在动作，联合世界模型解耦人类先验与机器人控制参数，并用轻量适配器进行本体微调。在三种机器人、五项真实任务上，域外平均成功率74%，高于重定向基线65%，跨本体累计耗时降低47.2%。该方法摆脱规则式重定向，为第一人称视频到灵巧操作提供可扩展路径。
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric human videos offer a scalable alternative to costly robot demonstra- tions, yet transferring their manipulation priors to robot control remains chal- lenging. The commonly adopted retargeting-based approaches convert human wrist and finger poses into embodiment-specific action commands through hand- crafted geometric mappings. However, such mappings require meticulous recal- ibration across different embodiments and risk propagating hand-tracking errors into downstream robot control pipelines. To this end, we propose EgoJEPA, a three-stage framework that learns embodiment-agnostic representations from ego- centric human videos without rule-based human-to-robot retargeting: 1) Human- action pre-training learns effect-aware latent actions through JEPA-style visual prediction conditioned on hand-motion differences; 2) Latent-action-based world modeling jointly predicts future visual dynamics and latent actions, which decou- ples human prior pre-training from robot-specific control parameterizations; 3) Embodiment-specific tuning adapts the pretrained model to diverse robots through lightweight action adapters. Experiments on five real-world manipulation tasks across three robot embodiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of EgoJEPA. It achieves a 74% average success rate under the out-of-domain evalu- ation, compared with 65% for the retargeting baseline, while reducing cumulative cross-embodiment wall-clock cost by 47.2%, from 743.2 to 392.7 hours.

papers.title_en: Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?
papers.authors: Yue Su, Bokai Lin, Xinkai Wang, Chubin Zhang, Xiangnan Wu, Kuan Zhang, Weiyang Jin, Jiwen Yu, Yiming Li, Cewu Lu, Lixin Yang, Xihui Liu
papers.evidence: 统一因果训练，将动作同时作为世界预测条件与策略学习目标
papers.tldr: 世界建模与动作学习能否在统一因果训练下互惠尚不明确。作者提出 OneWM，在同一视频-动作架构中把动作同时作为世界预测条件与策略学习目标，并在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa365 及真实实验中评估。结果显示，学习指定动作的视觉后果可提升策略性能与场景泛化，动作学习也提升多视角世界预测保真度。该工作正面回答双向收益问题，为统一世界-动作建模提供简洁训练框架。
papers.abstract_en: World and action modeling are closely related, yet their reciprocal benefits under unified causal training remain unclear. We introduce OneWM, a simple framework for unified causal training that treats actions as both conditions for world prediction and targets for policy learning within a shared video-action architecture. Using this framework, we investigate whether learning forward dynamics conditioned on specified actions improves action learning, and whether learning to generate actions in turn improves action-conditioned world modeling. We use LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa365 as embodied testbeds to evaluate both policy learning and world modeling, complemented by real-world policy experiments. Learning the visual consequences of specified actions improves policy performance and generalization across changing scenes. In turn, action learning improves multi-view world-prediction fidelity under the same architecture. Together, these results answer both questions positively, supporting reciprocal benefits between world modeling and action generation under unified causal training.

papers.title_en: Fast-VLA: You Only Think Once for Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Kehong Gong, Guanli Hou, Xiaoxu Zheng, Qi Wang, Mingxi Xu, Anbang Zhai, Xiaoyu He, Mingyuan Zhang, Michael Bi Mi
papers.evidence: 每回合仅调用一次视觉语言模型以加速VLA推理
papers.tldr: 现有VLA策略把数十亿参数模型放进控制闭环，每次预测动作块都重复计算任务上下文，推理开销大。Fast-VLA每回合仅调用一次冻结4B VLM，把指令和初始视图编码为固定多层KV任务记忆；执行时由轻量在线actor结合时间与机械臂索引查询及视觉、本体反馈，直接检索记忆并输出动作块。在RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上取得高成功率，并将RoboTwin摊销推理时间降低10.9-17.1倍，在线常驻内存仅1.22 GiB。该工作表明任务上下文可一次建立，同时保持闭环控制响应性。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly place a multi-billion-parameter model inside the feedback loop, repeatedly recomputing task context whenever they predict a new action chunk. Yet task understanding changes far more slowly than the robot state. We introduce Fast-VLA, which invokes a frozen 4B VLM once per episode to contextualize the instruction and initial views as fixed, multi-layer key-value task memory. During execution, a lightweight online actor fuses learned time- and arm-indexed queries with current visual and proprioceptive feedback to form action queries. These queries retrieve task context from the fixed memory and predict action chunks without re-running the foundation model. Fast-VLA achieves 92.46% and 92.40% success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean and Randomized, and 95.95% and 79.11% on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus evaluation. Against three continually conditioned baselines on the same hardware, it reduces RoboTwin amortized policy inference time by 10.9-17.1x and requires 1.22 GiB of post-prefill online resident memory. Task-memory swaps further show that the actor relies on episode-matched task memory. These results show that task context can be established once while closed-loop control remains responsive throughout execution. Project page: https://garfield-kh.github.io/FastVLA

papers.title_en: Cross-Embodiment Causal Transfer from Human Videos to Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Xingyu Zhang, Yingchao Li, Peizheng Guo, Jie Hu, Changwen Zheng, Wenwen Qiang
papers.evidence: 将人类视频中的子任务知识跨具身迁移到机器人操作
papers.tldr: 机器人操作数据稀缺，人类视频虽丰富却因形态与动作空间差异难以直接监督。论文提出因果束引导子任务迁移CBST，从人类视频学习操作表征，并用机器人示教将其锚定到任务级语义变量。方法以因果束约束筛选上下文信息，使保留语义能维持局部机制输出且对输入保持非平凡响应，再条件化世界-动作模型。基准实验表明任务成功率优于对应世界-动作模型基线。
papers.abstract_en: Scaling robot manipulation models requires large amounts of interaction data, yet collecting diverse real-robot experience remains costly. Human manipulation videos, in contrast, provide abundant and diverse task experience that could potentially benefit robot learning. However, differences in morphology, action spaces, and control mechanisms make human motions unsuitable as direct supervision for robot actions, raising a scientific question: what knowledge in human videos should be transferred across embodiments to robot manipulation? To address this question, we analyze subtask transfer through the lens of causal beams, focusing on which contextual conditions and interaction dependencies should be retained to support local task effects. Based on this perspective, we propose Causal-Beam-Guided Subtask Transfer (CBST). CBST learns manipulation-related representations from human videos and grounds them in task-level semantic variables using robot demonstrations. Within a predefined manipulation model, causal-beam constraints guide contextual information selection by requiring retained assignments to sustain local mechanism outputs while preserving nontrivial responsiveness to retained inputs. The selected semantic information conditions a world-action model, allowing the robot to generate actions from its own observations without requiring human-robot motion correspondence. Experiments on robot manipulation benchmarks show improvements in task success over the corresponding world-action model baselines.

papers.title_en: TS-WAM: Temporal Latent Actions and World-Action Coupling for Vision-Language Robot Control
papers.authors: Menghao Yin, Jiaju Yin, Xiyue Dong, Lixin Xu, Zhenhui Zhang, Ke Zhang, Yating Feng, Renjing Xu
papers.evidence: vlm-jepa自监督世界-动作模型与显式未来预测
papers.tldr: 现有视觉-语言-动作策略依赖动作标注示范，缺少未来视觉状态预测，难以利用无动作视频且易过拟合示范条件。TS-WAM以vlm-jepa自监督时序学习结合delta-lwm，联合优化时序表征、视觉动态与机器人控制，并从当前观测和指令预测潜在动作。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、SimplerEnv及Franka、RevoTron真机实验中，方法展现较强操作性能、泛化性与鲁棒性，且推理移除EMA目标分支保持轻量。
papers.abstract_en: Many vision-language-action policies rely on action-labeled robot demonstrations and lack an explicit mechanism for predicting future visual states. These limitations hinder learning from action-free videos and can encourage overfitting to demonstration conditions, weakening generalization and robustness. We present TS-WAM, a lightweight Teacher-Student World-Action Model that addresses these challenges through self-supervised temporal learning and explicit future prediction. Its vlm-jepa framework learns from heterogeneous data, including robot demonstrations and action-free human videos, using an EMA target branch without requiring a separately trained external teacher. By coupling vlm-jepa with delta-lwm, TS-WAM learns to predict latent actions from the current observation and instruction and uses them to predict future visual features that guide action generation at inference. A unified end-to-end training architecture jointly optimizes temporal representation learning, visual dynamics, and robot control without a separate latent-action or world-model pretraining stage. The EMA target branch is removed at inference, keeping the deployed policy lightweight. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv, together with real-world manipulation experiments on Franka Research 3 and RevoTron, demonstrate that TS-WAM achieves strong manipulation performance, generalization, and robustness.

papers.title_en: Dexterity from Supervised Play
papers.authors: Botao He, Yiming Dou, Yiannis Aloimonos, Jitendra Malik, Akash Sharma, Ruoshi Liu
papers.evidence: 基于世界模型的MPC与蒸馏策略加速推理
papers.tldr: 灵巧操作学习依赖大量接触丰富交互数据，而机器人自主采集这类经验仍然困难。DSP先通过行为克隆从数分钟人类玩耍中学习play策略，再让机器人自主运行收集数小时交互数据训练世界模型。推理时同一策略为MPC提出候选动作序列，并可在世界模型内通过自博弈蒸馏闭环目标条件策略以加速。真实实验成功率较hindsight行为克隆提升69.6%，与强化学习相当但交互数据少490倍，表明监督玩耍可支撑自主数据采集、模型规划与策略学习。
papers.abstract_en: How can robots autonomously collect the contact-rich experience needed to learn dexterous manipulation? We present DSP: Dexterity from supervised play, a framework in which a robot learns a play policy from minutes of human play through behavior cloning, then deploys it autonomously to collect hours of interaction data to train a world model. During inference, the same play policy then guides model-predictive control (MPC) by proposing candidate action sequences for evaluation under the learned world model. To accelerate inference, we also introduce a method for distilling a closed-loop, goal-conditioned policy through self-play within the learned world model. We evaluate this framework on underactuated pushing and any-to-any in-hand pose reorientation with a multifingered hand, in simulation and real world. In real world experiment, our method outperforms hindsight behavior cloning by 69.6% in success rate and achieves comparable success to reinforcement learning with 490 times less interaction data. These results demonstrate that supervised play can autonomously collect interaction data, guide model-based planning, and enable policy learning without any task-specific demonstrations or sim-to-real transfer.

papers.title_en: BeJEPA: A Goal-Conditioned Humanoid Behavior World Model via Unsupervised RL
papers.authors: Liyun Yan, Haoyang Li, Yang Zhang, Jialing Zhu, Zhanxiang Cao, Zihao Zhou, Keqi Zhu, Yizhi Chen, Huang Chuxuan, Shengcheng Fu, Zhong Jiangwei, Qiao Sun, Chen Zhang, Yue Gao
papers.evidence: 基于联合嵌入预测架构的目标条件世界模型
papers.tldr: 人形机器人需兼顾全身姿态与世界位置/朝向，传统根坐标系模仿在位移后难恢复目标世界位姿。BeJEPA用JEPA学习身体配置与世界放置共享表征，联合训练动态预测器与目标条件后继预测器，以一次物理预测和一次行为摘要引导策略改进，无需长时想象。20秒动作跟踪中较BFM-Zero和SONIC显著降低全局位置误差，并在Unitree G1实机实现姿态、位置、朝向目标、倒地恢复与扰动后闭环回归。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid control requires coordinating whole-body posture with position and heading in the world frame. Mainstream controllers imitate trajectories in the root frame, but struggle to regain the target world pose after displacement. We introduce BeJEPA, a goal-conditioned Behavior World Model learned through unsupervised reinforcement learning from human motion priors and robot interaction. BeJEPA learns a shared representation of body configuration and world placement through a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). A Dynamic Predictor predicts the next state embedding under an action, while a Successor Predictor summarizes a goal-conditioned policy's expected discounted future state embeddings in a single vector. During joint training, Dynamic grounds the initial representation in observed physical transitions, while Successor increasingly organizes it around long-term behavior. Their composition guides policy improvement through one physical prediction and one behavioral summary, without long imagined rollouts. In 20-second motion-tracking experiments, BeJEPA with online action refinement using Dynamic outperforms all evaluated baselines in global body-position error, reducing it on AMASS by 61.7% relative to BFM-Zero with world-pose inputs and 58.7% relative to SONIC. Physical deployment on a Unitree G1 demonstrates joint attainment of posture, world position, and heading goals, recovery from the ground, and closed-loop return after disturbances and goal changes. Project page: https://ylyem9x.github.io/BeJEPA-project.

papers.title_en: LAW: Unifying Language, Action, and World Modeling for Agentic Physical Intelligence
papers.authors: Jiajun Cao, Kai Tang, Bohua Zhang, Zezhong Qian, Ying Li, Xiaozhu Ju, Xiaobao Wei, Jiaming Liu, Yang Ding, Sixiang Chen, Yiding Sun, Siyuan Qian, Tinghao Wang, Jixian Wu, Yichen Guo, Yi Zhang, Shilong Zou, Yong Dai, Jian Tang, Shanghang Zhang
papers.evidence: 融合语言推理、动作生成与世界建模的闭环VLM-WAM框架
papers.tldr: 长程操作任务中，世界-动作模型虽能联合预测动作与未来状态，却缺少语言推理来规划子任务、评估进度。LAW 提出闭环 VLM–WAM 框架，以语义子任务进度统一语言推理、动作生成与世界建模：VLM 规划剩余子任务并融合世界-动作模型的候选动作，同时异步评估执行状态。在 50 项 RoboTwin 任务上平均成功率 94.21%，换用 OpenWAM-α 骨干升至 95.56%，刷新开源 SOTA。
papers.abstract_en: World-action models jointly predict actions and future world states, but long-horizon manipulation further requires language reasoning to plan subtask objectives, assess execution progress, and guide action selection. We present LAW, a closed-loop VLM--WAM framework that unifies language reasoning, action generation, and world modeling through semantic subtask progress. Within the LAW agent, a hybrid-expert vision-language model plans the remaining subtasks, estimates the values of and fuses actions proposed by a world-action model, and asynchronously assesses execution status to support continued execution and subtask transitions. Within the world-action model, Mixture-of-Transformer Experts integrates modality-specific and shared computation for joint video--action modeling. Dual-stream hierarchical visual memory maintains temporal context for both models, while subtask-local value learning aligns action evaluation with semantic objectives and preserves supervision from successful prefixes of failed trajectories. LAW achieves 94.21% average success across 50 RoboTwin tasks. Replacing the WAM backbone with OpenWAM-$alpha$ further raises the average success rate to 95.56%, establishing a new open-source state of the art on RoboTwin. Despite having only 2B parameters, our VLM also outperforms variants using Embodied-R1.5 and GPT-5.5 High. On three long-horizon real-robot tasks, LAW achieves 65% average success, compared with 28.33% for $pi_{0.5}$ and 25% for Fast-WAM.

papers.title_en: Beyond Action Prediction: Learning Search-Free Planning in Latent Space
papers.authors: Guanchen Du, Jinhao Du, Yanpeng Sun, Shan Zhang, Na Zhao, Zechao Li
papers.evidence: 基于JEPA逆模型的潜世界模型免搜索规划
papers.tldr: 潜在世界模型规划通常需在测试时搜索动作序列，代价高。HIJP用目标条件逆模型直接由当前与目标观测预测动作，并以离线轨迹未来观测重标目标、保留目标表示梯度、约束动作与潜在转移一致来训练。四个视觉控制任务总体成功率86.8%，规划加速1.9-16.5倍。该工作实现了无搜索的多步潜在规划。
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models learn action-conditioned state transitions in a compact representation space, providing a predictive model for visual planning and control. However, planning with these models typically requires costly test-time optimization over action sequences. We propose to replace this online search with a goal-conditioned inverse model that directly predicts actions from current and goal observations. A key challenge is that action prediction alone neither ensures that goal representations encode action-relevant information nor that predicted actions are consistent with the learned latent prediction model. We introduce Hindsight Inverse JEPA Planning (HIJP), a search-free framework that addresses both aspects during training. HIJP relabels future observations along offline trajectories as goals, providing action supervision across multiple temporal horizons. By retaining gradients through the goal representations, this supervision directly shapes the visual representation. HIJP further feeds predicted actions into the latent predictor model and aligns the resulting next-state representations with encoded successor observations, enforcing action-transition consistency. At inference time, the inverse dynamics model and latent predictor models are applied alternately to generate multi-step action sequences without online search. Across four visual control tasks, HIJP achieves 86.8% overall success and a 1.9-16.5x planning speedup over search-based planning.

papers.title_en: RM-WAM: Reliable Memory-Augmented World Action Models for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Cui Miao, Junhao Yu, Ping Liu, Ning Yang, Xuhua Chen, He Zheng, Xiaodong Wang, Tao Zhang
papers.evidence: 记忆增强的世界动作模型联合预测未来状态与动作，服务长程操作决策与控制
papers.tldr: 长程机器人操作中，现有世界动作模型多依赖当前观测，视觉相似状态可能对应不同历史与任务阶段，直接引入历史又易带来过期或错误信息。RM-WAM将记忆视为依上下文取舍的预测资源，用短期视觉状态记忆与潜在事件记忆表征历史，并通过反事实记忆学习估计记忆效用，以效用感知门控自适应注入世界动作主干。实验表明，可靠且选择性的记忆利用对长程任务至关重要。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by jointly predicting future visual states and actions, yet most existing methods make decisions primarily from the current observation. This limits their reliability in long-horizon tasks, where visually similar states may correspond to different interaction histories and task stages. Moreover, directly incorporating historical observations can introduce stale, stage-mismatched, or error-contaminated information, leading to inaccurate world prediction and accumulated closed-loop errors. We propose RM-WAM, a reliable memory-augmented World Action Model that treats memory as a context-dependent predictive resource rather than universally useful historical context. RM-WAM represents history using complementary short-term visual state memory and latent event memory, which respectively capture recent interaction dynamics and longer-term state transitions. A counterfactual memory learning scheme varies the accessible history while keeping the current inputs and prediction targets fixed, enabling the model to learn a context-dependent utility estimate for historical memory. Based on this estimate, a utility-aware gating mechanism adaptively controls memory injection into the world-action backbone. Experiments demonstrate that RM-WAM highlights the importance of reliable and selective memory utilization in long-horizon tasks.

papers.title_en: StreamingWAM: Streaming World Action Modeling via Chunk-Wise Staircase Flow Matching
papers.authors: Shaojie Ren, Jingwen Sun, Zezhi Liu, Hongjin Chen, Xin Jin, Wei Zou, Zhibo Chen
papers.evidence: 面向世界动作模型机器人控制的流式扩散，兼顾推理效率与连续性
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型在真实机器人部署中常出现动作不连续和抖动，已有方法难以同时兼顾推理效率与跨块连续性。StreamingWAM提出流式扩散框架，以噪声阶梯实现分块动作预测，并用前缀滚动和密集视频历史记忆保障跨块与时序一致。实验覆盖LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0及真实任务，稳态重规划延迟降至仿真72.9 ms、真机57.3 ms，动作更平滑且降低对执行时域K的敏感性。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs), often built upon pretrained video-generation world models, have emerged as a promising framework for general-purpose and open-ended robot control. However, their real-world deployment often suffers from discontinuous and jerky execution. Existing methods typically address this issue by either improving inference efficiency or enhancing action continuity across prediction chunks, without jointly addressing both challenges. To bridge this gap, we propose StreamingWAM, a streaming-diffusion framework for WAM-based robot control. StreamingWAM combines a noise ladder for chunk-wise action prediction, a prefix rollout module for cross-chunk continuity, and dense video-history memory for temporally consistent conditioning. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that StreamingWAM improves action continuity across static and dynamic settings, achieving competitive performance while reducing steady-state replanning latency to 72.9 ms in simulation and 57.3 ms on the real robot. The method also produces smoother action transitions, while the streaming staircase reduces sensitivity to the execution horizon K.

papers.title_en: Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement for Navigation via Policy-Synchronized Language-Action Dual Bootstrapping
papers.authors: Songze Li, Haoming Gu, Ziyang Gong, Zhitong Wang, Gengze Zhou, Zun Wang, Yuhan Zhu, Tianxiang Jiang, Juanzi Li, Qi Wu, Weinan Zhang, Yu Qiao, Wenwei Zhang, Yi Wang
papers.evidence: 以数据为中心的递归自我改进与可扩展语言监督合成
papers.tldr: 视觉语言导航依赖高质量语言监督，但人工标注昂贵，现有合成方法常分离导航与指令生成，或先固定模型标注全量数据，导致监督滞后于策略。RSI-Nav以共享模型统一指令跟随与指令生成，并按小分片递归自提升：生成指令、执行评估、保留合格样本后立即更新。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上分别达到68.6%和72.4%成功率，并提升指令生成与空间理解。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language navigation requires agents to follow natural-language instructions to reach target locations, making high-quality language supervision essential. Since human annotation is costly, prior work has explored scalable data synthesis methods. However, existing methods typically either use separate models for navigation and instruction generation or couple the two tasks through task-specific components; most also annotate the full trajectory corpus with a fixed model before updating, which can cause generated supervision to lag behind the evolving policy. Therefore, we introduce RSI-Nav, a data-centric recursive self-improvement framework for navigation via policy-synchronized language-action dual bootstrapping, which unifies vision-language-to-action instruction following and vision-action-to-language instruction generation within a shared model. Specifically, after supervised fine-tuning establishes fundamental capabilities, RSI-Nav progressively processes unlabeled trajectories in small shards. The current model generates instructions for these trajectories, executes them to evaluate goal completion and path efficiency, retains qualified samples, and immediately updates itself before processing the next shard. This shard-wise update keeps newly generated supervision aligned with the evolving policy. We also incorporate spatial understanding data, since stronger spatial reasoning benefits navigation. Extensive experiments show that RSI-Nav reaches 68.6% SR on R2R-CE and 72.4% SR on RxR-CE, while providing stronger instruction-generation utility and modestly improved spatial understanding after recursive evolution.

papers.title_en: $Δ$ Flow Matching for Robot Foundation Models
papers.authors: Kuangji Zuo, Tuo An, Xinying Guo, Gen Li, Mengfei Zhao, Jiaqi Bai, Bofan Lyu, Zhuoyuan Yu, Jinghan Yang, Jiayi Li, Jindou Jia, Jianfei Yang
papers.evidence: 基于历史的源分布实现VLA与世界动作模型的单步推理
papers.tldr: 机器人基础模型的流匹配通常从固定高斯先验生成动作块或未来视觉状态，忽略历史连续性且推理慢。Δ-flow 用近期历史加轻噪声构造源分布，使源更接近目标，只需学习小残差 Δ，并支持单步推理。在 LIBERO 上，ImageWAM 一个 epoch 达 90%，Fast-WAM 两个 epoch 达 95%，单步推理分别加速 1.54×、2.49×、4.45×，动作抖动降低 4.5×。该方法简单有效，提升效率与泛化，并可在不重训的情况下用于预训练 WAM。
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching is a common generative recipe for robot foundation models. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) generate action chunks, while world-action models (WAMs) additionally generate future visual states. Both start generation from a fixed Gaussian prior, despite temporal continuity between past and future states and actions. This requires costly training and iterative sampling, especially for WAMs with an additional visual branch. We introduce $Δ$-flow, which constructs the source from recent history with mild noise rather than from a fixed Gaussian prior. This moves the source closer to the target, reducing transport to a small residual $Δ$ that can be learned efficiently and enables single-step inference. We integrate $Δ$-flow into the VLA policy $π_{0.5}$ and the WAM policies ImageWAM and Fast-WAM. On LIBERO, ImageWAM reaches 90% success in one epoch rather than six, and Fast-WAM reaches 95% in two epochs rather than eight. With LoRA fine-tuning, $π_{0.5}$ exceeds its baseline's five-epoch performance after one epoch. Single-step inference gives $1.54\times$, $2.49\times$, and $4.45\times$ speedups on $π_{0.5}$, ImageWAM, and Fast-WAM, respectively. It preserves action smoothness, achieving a $4.5\times$ reduction in action jerk compared with one-step Gaussian sampling. $Δ$-flow reaches state-of-the-art generalization performance on LIBERO-Plus. Action-history sources can be applied to pretrained WAM policies without retraining. Replacing the Gaussian action source at inference largely preserves task success with a single sampling step and can slightly improve it. We further study how action representation and visual information in action learning affect history-to-future prediction in $Δ$-flow. These results show that $Δ$-flow is simple yet effective, improving the efficiency and generalization of robot foundation models.

papers.title_en: StateSkill-Agent: An Effective and Efficient Embodied Agent via State-conditioned Skill
papers.authors: Changxu Wei, Jingyi Zhang, Zhiyu Zheng, Tianyi Lin, Yixian Zhang, Yunpeng Qing, Jingyuan Liu, Zhi Hou, Jiaxing Huang
papers.evidence: 具身多模态大模型智能体复用可迁移的状态条件技能
papers.tldr: 具身MLLM智能体需要理解并完成复杂任务，但现有方法难以学习、抽象和复用可迁移、可泛化的行为模式。本文提出StateSkill，将交互经验建模为有限状态机，以任务进度状态、状态转移和状态条件引导组织技能，使技能上下文保持紧凑且与阶段相关。进一步提出StateSkill-Evolve与StateGRPO，通过成功和失败轨迹的回顾分析迭代细化技能，并在统一循环中实现技能演化与模型优化协同共进。实验表明，训练得到的StateSkill-Agent在多种具身任务上兼具有效性与高效性，为动态可调整的技能学习提供了新范式。
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we aim to develop an embodied MLLM agent that understands and solves embodied tasks by learning, abstracting, and reusing transferrable and generalizable behavioral patterns. To this end, we propose StateSkill, a new skill representation for embodied agents, which introduces the concept of "finite-state machines" into skill modeling for effective and efficient skill construction and learning. The core idea of StateSkill is to model embodied interaction experiences as a finite-state machine, where a skill is organized around a set of task-progress states, state transitions, and state-conditioned guidance, enabling embodied agents to dynamically adjust their skills as the task progresses while keeping skill contexts compact and stage-relevant. We further develop StateSkill-Evolve, an experience-driven evolution mechanism that iteratively refines StateSkill through retrospective analysis of new successful and failed state-guided trajectories. Upon this, we introduce StateGRPO, which integrates StateSkill evolution and model optimization via state-conditioned GRPO into a unified iterative learning loop, enabling state-conditioned skills and model capabilities to co-evolve and reinforce each other. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed methods and trained model (i.e., StateSkill-Agent) across various embodied tasks.

papers.title_en: MORE: Learning Motion-Oriented Registers for Driving World Models and Planning
papers.authors: Yingdong Gu, Haoyu Wang, Shaocheng Yan, Zhenjun Zhao, Hao Han, Pengcheng Shi, Xianfei Li, Qinghua Tan, Wenlong Liao, Tao He, Jiayuan Li, Pai Peng
papers.evidence: 面向未来预测与规划的运动导向寄存器潜空间世界模型
papers.tldr: 现有驾驶世界模型多继承预训练视觉编码器的密集特征，导致世界状态接口与运动条件建模、规划需求不匹配，且高分辨率下计算昂贵。MORE在视频预训练中学习运动导向寄存器（Motion-Oriented Registers），注入时间对齐自车运动，并以其作为掩码块预测的唯一上下文，形成紧凑共享状态瓶颈。在NAVSIM-v2上，MORE的EPDMS较SOTA提升1.6，推理延迟仅为DriveLaW的1/10。该工作表明可直接在视频预训练中学习面向世界建模与规划的状态接口。
papers.abstract_en: By predicting future states, latent world models provide rich self-supervision for end-to-end driving, but often inherit dense features from pretrained visual encoders as their world-state interface. This creates a mismatch: visual pretraining produces information-rich, spatially dense features, but their adaptation for motion-conditioned world modeling and planning is deferred to downstream training. The dense grid also makes future prediction more computationally expensive as visual resolution increases. We therefore argue that video pretraining should directly learn state representations suited to downstream world modeling and planning, rather than relying on downstream training to adapt inherited visual features. We propose ***MORE***, a V-JEPA framework that learns **M**otion-**O**riented **RE**gisters during video pretraining as a shared state interface for driving world models and planning. MORE injects temporally aligned ego motion into a small set of registers and uses them as the sole context for masked patch prediction, channeling dense patch-level supervision through a compact state bottleneck. A complementary blockwise register-masking objective further shapes predictive structure in the register space. During downstream training, the same register space defines the future states predicted by the world model and provides shared scene memory for trajectory generation and scoring. On NAVSIM-v2, MORE outperforms the state of the art by 1.6 in EPDMS, while achieving superior efficiency with only 1/10 the inference latency of DriveLaW. These results support learning the state interface for world modeling and planning directly during video pretraining.

papers.title_en: Interactive Navigation Beyond Reachability: Benchmark and Agentic Framework
papers.authors: Delun Li, Xueyao Wei, Rui Chen, Yifei Wang, Junzhi Yu, Wenjie Song, Xingyu Chen
papers.evidence: 具身交互式导航基准与智能体框架
papers.tldr: 现有具身导航多假设可通行性与物体状态固定，但到达目标常需开门、开容器并处理顺序依赖。论文提出超越可达性的交互导航任务，构建3K回合ObjectGoal基准MultINav-Bench，并提供交互必要性标注。作者提出基于持久状态交互图的三阶段智能体MultINav-Agent，联合语义感知、VLM动作选择与交互后验证。实验显示其在通道、容器及混合任务上稳定优于适配基线。
papers.abstract_en: Existing embodied navigation tasks commonly assume that traversability and object states remain fixed during an episode. Yet reaching a goal may require opening a door to access a room and then opening a container to reveal a hidden target. We formulate interactive navigation beyond reachability, unifying channel-induced changes in spatial connectivity, container-induced changes in target visibility, and their sequential dependencies. We introduce MultINav-Bench, a 3K-episode ObjectGoal benchmark in MolmoSpaces spanning channel, container, and mixed tasks, with interaction-necessity annotations covering required and unnecessary episodes. Its data generation pipeline automates task construction across multiple task types. The evaluation protocol separately measures navigation success, interaction effectiveness, and cost. We further propose MultINav-Agent, a three-stage agentic framework built on a persistent, state-conditioned interaction graph. Semantic interactive perception grounds entities and interaction states; a vision-language model selects task-relevant actions based on expected changes in connectivity and target observability; and post-interaction verification updates the graph to guide subsequent navigation, exploration, or interaction. Experiments on MultINav-Bench show that MultINav-Agent consistently outperforms adapted baselines across channel, container, and mixed tasks.

papers.title_en: Generative Flow on Symbolic Abstractions for Embodiment Capability Discovery
papers.authors: Youwei Yu, Lantao Liu
papers.evidence: 学习接地的生成式任务生成器，产生本体可行的训练任务以缓解数据与任务稀缺
papers.tldr: 现有机器人训练任务多由手工设计或LLM按语义合理性生成，易忽略具体具身可行性，导致课程过难、冗余或错过可学行为。FOSA将抽象策略参数化为生成流网络，构造符号任务骨架，并以仿真中底层策略学习表现作为奖励，发现贴近机器人能力前沿的可执行任务。跨异构平台实验显示其能生成多样任务；将任务策略蒸馏为单一语言条件策略后，可提升未见复杂长时任务表现。
papers.abstract_en: Achieving complex, long-horizon robot behavior remains challenging because successful execution depends on skills grounded in a robot's physical affordances. Existing training-task distributions are often handcrafted or sampled from large language models (LLMs), relying on semantic plausibility rather than embodiment-specific feasibility. This mismatch can produce curricula that are too difficult, redundant, or blind to non-obvious but learnable behaviors. We propose Generative Flow on Symbolic Abstractions (FOSA), a framework for discovering embodiment-specific capabilities by learning a grounded task generator. FOSA parameterizes an abstract policy as a Generative Flow Network that constructs symbolic task skeletons. Each skeleton is compiled into a simulation environment, where low-level policy-learning performance provides the reward signal for the abstract policy. Across heterogeneous robot platforms, FOSA discovers diverse and executable tasks near the robot's empirical capability frontier. After distilling the discovered task policies into a single language-conditioned policy, FOSA improves performance on unseen complex and long-horizon tasks. The code and demonstration videos are available at https://www.youwei-yu.com/fosa.

papers.title_en: MOSAIC: Mode- and Support-Aware Inference-Time Control of Robot Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Sabrina Bodmer, Rahel Rickenbach, René Zurbrügg, Melanie N. Zeilinger, Colin Jones
papers.evidence: 机器人扩散策略的推理时控制
papers.tldr: 机器人扩散策略部署时常遇训练未覆盖的约束与目标，现有推理时引导易偏离先验、采样低效或模式坍缩。MOSAIC 提出模式与支撑感知的无梯度控制，将初始噪声及反向步扰动作为联合输入，用全去噪输出的重要性权重自适应输入分布。它用自适应惩罚平衡物理可行性与先验支撑一致性，按模式加权更新保留多模态，并借共享耦合代价协同多个独立扩散模型；在导航、灵巧抓取、未见几何规划与协作搬箱中无需重训即可适配冻结先验。
papers.abstract_en: Generative policies such as diffusion models provide expressive data-driven priors for robot behavior, yet the situations a robot faces at execution time rarely match its training data and impose constraints and objectives the policy never learned. Existing inference-time guidance methods either rely on gradients that can push samples away from the learned prior, or on sampling procedures that can be inefficient, collapse modes, or average them into out-of-distribution predictions.   We introduce MOSAIC, a mode- and support-aware framework for gradient-free inference-time control of robotic diffusion models. MOSAIC treats the initial noise and all stochastic reverse-step perturbations as a joint input to the pretrained denoising process and adapts a distribution over this input using importance weights computed from fully denoised outputs. Physical feasibility and consistency with the learned support are balanced using adaptive penalties, while mode-wise importance-weighted updates preserve modes and avoid destructive averaging.   The same formulation can jointly steer multiple independently trained diffusion models through shared coupling costs, enabling coordinated behavior without requiring a joint model. We evaluate MOSAIC on navigation, dexterous grasping, motion planning with unseen geometry, and collaborative box manipulation with independently trained robot priors. Across these settings, MOSAIC adapts and composes frozen diffusion priors under new deployment constraints without retraining.

papers.title_en: Value-Preserving Action Quantization
papers.authors: Max Muchen Sun, Jueun Kwon, Benjamin Riviere, Todd Murphey
papers.evidence: 面向搜索式机器人策略学习与规划的价值保持动作量化
papers.tldr: 在机器人策略学习中，MCTS等搜索方法需将连续动作离散化，但仅优化动作重构误差未必能保持动作对未来状态与价值的影响。作者证明动作量化引起的价值误差受量化动作下状态可达性重构误差紧约束，并提出保持状态可达性的VAQ及VAQ-MCTS行为克隆框架。在物体推动任务中，VAQ-MCTS性能匹配或超过先进行为克隆方法，并提升数据效率、异构演示鲁棒性与零样本新环境适应；真实硬件30次试验全部完成，仅用10分钟演示数据。
papers.abstract_en: Search-based policy learning, such as Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), offers the flexibility to trade runtime computation for data efficiency and adaptation to novel environments. For robot learning, however, applying search requires discretizing the continuous action space and associated dynamics, typically through action quantization. While reconstruction-based quantization is sufficient for representing the continuous action space alone, policy learning additionally requires the quantized actions to preserve their effects on future states and values. We show that such requirement is not necessarily captured by action reconstruction error. Instead, we prove that the error in the value function resulting from action quantization is tightly bounded by the reconstruction error of state reachability under the quantized actions. Based on these results, we propose value-preserving action quantization (VAQ), which quantizes actions by preserving state reachability. We further combine VAQ with MCTS (VAQ-MCTS) as a value-preserving, search-based policy learning framework for behavioral cloning. Using a wide range of object pushing tasks as a controlled benchmark, we evaluate VAQ-MCTS against state-of-the-art behavioral cloning methods. VAQ-MCTS matches or exceeds their performance under standard settings, while substantially improving data efficiency and robustness to heterogeneous demonstrations, while enabling zero-shot adaptation to novel environments. Hardware experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of VAQ-MCTS, completing all 30 real-world object pushing trials with only 10 minutes of demonstration data.

papers.title_en: Robota-Embed: Unified VLA Embeddings for Robot In-Context Learning and Evolution
papers.authors: Yunze Liu, Jing Wang, Shenrui Wu, Wenkun He, Guanqi Zhan, Xianzheng Ma, Junyu Chen, Wenhang Ge, Haozhan Tang, Yuchao Gu, Zhuoyang Zhang, Zekai Wang, Dantong Niu, Zhen Dong, Yuke Zhu, Trevor Darrell, Linxi "Jim" Fan, Song Han, Han Cai
papers.evidence: 统一VLA嵌入实现无需参数更新的机器人上下文学习
papers.tldr: 机器人上下文检索需同时匹配任务、执行阶段与后续动作，现有VLA嵌入往往难以联合编码视觉、语言和动作。Robota-Embed以预测式检索训练统一VLA嵌入，联合编码当前查询与记录的未来延续，使历史片段可在推理时作为上下文。模型在自建基准取得47.33%片段级和81.77%回合级R@1，明显超过无动作基线。检索经验进一步用于策略条件化与任务本地记忆演化，提升仿真和真实机器人表现并减少策略令牌消耗。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieving useful context for a robot requires matching its task, execution stage, and the continuation that should follow. We introduce Robota-Embed, to our knowledge the first vision-language-action (VLA) embedding model to jointly encode all three modalities in both current-state queries and recorded future continuations. Predictive retrieval training aligns these endpoints, enabling historical continuations to serve as context at inference time. We construct a multi-source corpus of 1,695,684 cleaned training anchors and introduce Robota-Embed-Bench, with 4,000 queries and a shared 8,000-entry gallery. Robota-Embed achieves 47.33% clip-level and 81.77% episode-level R@1, exceeding action-free Gemini Embedding 2 by 22.09 and 33.47 percentage points. Controlled retrieval studies show that removing native action degrades retrieval more than removing vision. We study two complementary applications. Embed2ICL uses retrieved experience for training-free and training-based policy conditioning, increasing success from 47.0% to 56.3% in DROID-Sim and from 86.4% to 92.8% on the LIBERO difficult subset, while improving task progress on real robots. Embed2Evolve uses execution feedback to grow task-local memory and refine context use around a frozen GPT-6 Astra policy. Across five ManiSkill tasks, it achieves 68% success, compared with 24% for GPT-6 Astra Direct and 33% for a harness independently evolved with Omni-Embed-Nemotron-3B under the same protocol. Relative to the latter, it uses approximately 79.5% fewer policy tokens per test rollout, counting both successes and failures. These results show that a unified, action-aware retrieval space can support robot in-context learning and task-local context evolution.
